نرتكز (form VIII)
# نَرْتَكِزُ (nartakizu) /nar.ta.ki.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَزَ (irtakaza)
# نَرْتَكِزَ (nartakiza) /nar.ta.ki.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَزَ (irtakaza)
# نَرْتَكِزْ (nartakiz) /nar.ta.kiz/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَكَزَ (irtakaza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
